description: Open the page headless and read the running scene through three's devtools hook: the scene graph (types, names, positions, geometry, materials, lights), the camera, renderer stats (draw calls, triangles, geometries, textures) and whether GPU memory keeps growing. Diagnoses why objects are not visible: no lights, camera inside or pointed away, behind the camera, beyond far, zero scale, NaN positions, invisible materials, wrong layers, stretched aspect, shadows switched off. Use it when a scene is black, empty or wrong, before guessing.

leak_ms.description: Sample GPU memory this many ms apart (default 1500, 0 = off).

steps.description: Interactions before the screenshot: click (selector or x,y), press (key), drag, wheel, wait, wait-for.

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

name: three_inspect
title: Inspect the live three.js scene
